text:
zoe: Pinging the docs squad  opened a tiny PR to fix a couple console/observability examples that broke in the playground and to harmonize SDK snippet naming. Quick review appreciated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123 :pray:

raul: link works. what broke exactly?

zoe: two things: 1) our dashboard example still queries `latency_ms` so the sample panel renders blank (our exporters now emit p50/p95 quantiles). 2) Node SDK snippet uses `traceKeyHeader` (camelCase) while others use `trace_key_header` (snake_case) — inconsistent and confusing.

ivy: can you paste old vs new yaml and node snippet?

zoe: old dashboard fragment:```yaml
panels:
  - title: "Latency (by route)"
    type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
```
new fragment:```yaml
panels:
  - title: "Latency (by route)"
    type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
    note: "p95 collapsed by default to reduce visual noise"
```

zoe: Node snippet old->new:```js
// old
new TraceHook({ header: 'x-rw-trace', traceKeyHeader: 'x-rw-trace' })
// new (normalized)
new TraceHook({ header: 'x-rw-trace', trace_key_header: 'x-rw-trace-key' })
// note: traceKeyHeader still accepted as alias for now, but docs use trace_key_header
```

raul: good catch. I also want a one-liner under the chart explaining p50 vs p95. ops folks kept asking in the demo.

ivy: add a troubleshooting bullet: "If chart shows no data, verify your telemetry emits p50/p95 quantiles and not legacy metric names." Also we should inline the YAML (avoid anchors) because the importer choked on anchors in the past.

zoe: added the one-liner and inlined the panel blocks in the PR. Also replaced an external blog link that returned 410 with /docs/perf/primer. Left a short changelog entry.

docs-bot: CI: initial build failed  linkcheck: 404 at /console/observability/old-latency-guide; linter warns about deprecated field `latency_ms` found in examples/dashboard-examples.yaml

infra-bot: infra-note: I queued a lightweight scan to flag `*_ms` patterns in docs examples and will post results to #eng-infra tomorrow.

raul: approved with one nit: use snake_case in Node to match other languages and add a brief compatibility note about the alias. Otherwise LGTM.

zoe: thanks! updated snippet, fixed a tiny fence-language nit per the linter, pushed.

docs-bot: PR merged by zoe (docs CI: success)  site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-28 01:00 UTC

zoe: closing this thread. Follow-up: I'll coordinate with infra to land the redirect for the old guide path after deploy. Thanks all. :tada:
